header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH KARACHI
Date Order with signature(s) of Judge(s)
Petitioners and their counsel are called absent without any
body: intimation. Perusal of record shows that this petition was filed on 10.08.2023 and lastly fixed before the Court on 02.11.2023 when none appeared for the petitioners. Today same is the position although the name of the counsel for the petitioners has appeared in the cause list. It appears that the petitioners and their counsel have lost interest in pursuing this petition, which has been filed in the year 2023 yet they have not taken any steps to get it fixed before the Court. Accordingly, this petitions along with listed applications is hereby dismissed in default for non-prosecution.
JUDGE HEAD OF CONST. BENCHES JUDGE Azeem
